description: Error kinds carried in error.data.kind. Clients branch on the kind only. Append-only within protocol major 1; clients must accept kinds they do not know and treat them like INTERNAL. jsonrpcCode is the default JSON-RPC error code for the kind; PROTOCOL.md section 17.2 lists the reasons that use a different code. retryable is the default; the value in each error instance is authoritative.

entries.description: The session.hello token is wrong, or params has no string token or no protocol of the form MAJOR.MINOR. Sent only as the fixed pre-authentication response; the server closes the connection after sending it.
The protocol major version requested in session.hello is not served by this instance. Sent only as the fixed pre-authentication response; the server closes the connection after sending it.
The control API is stopping. The request was not executed. Pending job.get waits end with this error.
The message or its parameters are invalid, or the request is not allowed in the current state for a reason the caller can fix by changing the request.
A handle, job or file does not exist, or a handle is stale.
The target content is not ready for the request yet, for example because pitch analysis or note generation has not finished.
Pitch analysis of the target content failed.
Rendering the corrected audio failed, also after the one automatic retry.
A model or inference backend needed by the request is missing or could not be loaded.
An expected revision token no longer matches, or the state changed while the request was running. The reason names the aspect. Re-read and decide again.
The undo or redo history does not have the expected entry on top, or the entry must not be applied without force.
The request would discard unsaved project changes and the caller did not allow that.
The target already exists and the request does not allow replacing it.
The request was refused because the user, the UI or another operation is using the resource. Nothing was executed.
The request did not start executing before the dispatch deadline and was abandoned. executed is always false: the request has not run and will never run.
The job was cancelled through job.cancel. Used in the error member of a cancelled job.
Reading or writing a file failed.
The method, operation or target is not supported by this instance, this build or OpenTune itself.
An unexpected error inside the server. executed tells whether state may have changed.
